name: What should I ask before hiring a saltwater pool builder?

mainEntity.name: Which questions reveal whether a contractor really understands saltwater pool construction and not just standard pool building?
mainEntity.text: Which questions reveal whether a contractor really understands saltwater pool construction and not just standard pool building?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right questions can reveal whether a contractor truly understands saltwater pool construction. Ask how they size the salt cell, what pool volume assumptions they use, and whether they oversize the generator for summer demand. Ask which pumps, heaters, fasteners, tile, coping, and deck materials they specify for salt compatibility. It is also smart to ask how they prevent corrosion, how they handle startup balancing, and what the warranty covers for both the pool finish and the generator. A strong builder should be able to explain circulation, bonding, electrical safety, and maintenance in plain language. They should also tell you what happens if the water chemistry drifts or if the cell needs replacement later. If answers are vague or the proposal treats the salt system as an afterthought, the project may be underdesigned. For a luxury build, the contractor should show that saltwater performance is part of the design, not just an add-on.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask how they size the salt cell, what materials they use near the waterline, how they prevent corrosion, what warranty applies to the generator and finish, and how they handle startup and training. A qualified builder should explain circulation, bonding, and maintenance in plain language. Vague answers are a warning sign.
